limits: Fresh independent raw pinned OpenCode Go C selection over owned HTTPS/SSE;twenty actual C profiles from31 chats,five A/six R not executed in this acquisition. Explicit supplied key/high except Kimi K3 max/max64/cache-none/no session/env{}/network-none/maxRetries0. Only baseUrl changes to an owned loopback path retaining opencode.ai detection substring and authenticated physical /zen/go/v1 path;no model compat/options override. Already-normalized replay uses {messages} directly. Reference-only transform/JIT flags are not canonical application argv. Synthetic opaque/JSON/signature/counter bytes do not certify crypto,billing,tokenizer,service/account,upstream JSON,defaults/simple/context/reserve/media/host/lifecycle. No Core execution,dependency or image preparation. Core nonstream JSON envelopes are separately synthesized from actual completed SDK stream results,not observed upstream JSON. Native reference requests are stream:true;Core chat request comparisons explicitly set stream:false and omit stream_options. Existing image attribution remains separate from this zero-image SDK acquisition.
